question: What does seedless initiation accomplish for the ripe candidate?
premises: Seedless initiation addresses the bond of pledge-conduct.
Initiation alone can bring liberation in this case.
Constant devotion to god and guru supports that liberation.
inference: In seedless initiation, purification of the pledge-bond leads to liberation through initiation itself together with steady devotion.
uncertainties: The verse leaves open whether devotion is a separate cause or the mode in which initiation becomes effective.
plain_english: In the seedless initiation, one should purify the bond of pledge-conduct. Liberation can come through initiation alone, together with constant devotion to God and to the guru.
